next_label: Nvidia results, first under interim CEO
since_label: Fri 6 Nov close, the last price before the weekend reports
sources: Nvidia, CNBC, Reuters, Forbes, Yahoo Finance, Forex.com
status: Forbes and Yahoo Finance reported over the weekend that Huang is weighing a return, and CNBC and Reuters cite sources saying the board is not considering it. Nvidia reports third-quarter results after the US close on Tue 17 Nov, its first under interim CEO Colette Kress, with no permanent successor named.
title: Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO, Kress named interim
why: Nvidia is the anchor of the AI trade and one of the heaviest weights in the Nasdaq, which alts follow.

since_label: Tue 10 Nov, when the price range was set
sources: Anthropic, Bloomberg, Yahoo Finance, Reuters, Silicon Republic
status: Bloomberg reports orders at about six times the shares on offer, and Yahoo Finance puts the combined offerings at $90.4B; the filed range is still $70 to $78. Pricing is expected on Wed 18 Nov and first trade on Nasdaq as ANT on Thu 19 Nov.
title: Anthropic IPO, the largest AI listing
why: A raise this size absorbs cash that would otherwise chase other risk, and its first-day close reprices every AI name.

since_label: Wed 11 Nov close, before MSCI's after-hours announcement
sources: 24/7 Wall St., Decrypt, Yahoo Finance, Cointelegraph, ChainCatcher
status: MSCI's removal of Strategy from its USA and global indexes takes effect after the close on 30 Nov. Crypto Times reports Strategy is now below its roughly $75K average bitcoin cost, and ChainCatcher lists the deletion among the pressures behind this week's BTC fall.
title: MSCI drops Strategy from its indexes
why: Strategy is the largest corporate BTC holder, and forced selling of its shares tests the main route equity money takes into bitcoin.

since_label: Thu 12 Nov 00:00 UTC, before Iran reported the Sirik strike
sources: Reuters, AFP, Gulf News, New York Times, CoinDesk
status: Gulf News reports a third US carrier group entered the region on 15 Nov and the New York Times reports US and Israeli plans for possible strikes on Iranian energy sites. The blockade of Iranian ports stays in place; Iran says it could reopen Hormuz within two days if its conditions are met, with Pakistan-led talks under way.
title: Iran and US trade strikes in the Gulf
why: CoinDesk cites the Gulf escalation, with the dollar and Fed hike odds, behind the crypto sell-off; oil feeds straight into rate expectations.
